errors.evidence: The description claims the bars are sorted in descending order, but the values are 41%, 16%, 25%, and 18%, which is not a sorted sequence.
The description states that the bars are not shaded. However, the bars have a 3D effect which is created by shading (different tones on the different faces of the bars).
The term "highest" (най-високият) is ambiguous for a horizontal bar chart. "Longest" would be a more precise term.
